study.title: AgriSegNet: Deep Aerial Semantic Segmentation Framework for IoT-Assisted Precision Agriculture
study.short_title: AgriSegNet: Deep Aerial Semantic Segmentation Framework for IoT-Assisted Precision Agriculture

models_tested: AgriSegNet (hierarchical multi-scale attention on DeepLabV3+ backbone)

dataset.name: Agriculture-Vision challenge dataset (public benchmark; 21,061 aerial farmland images across the United States, 2019)
dataset.note: 512x512, RGB+NIR (4 channels); 12,901 train / 4,431 validation / 3,729 test; 7 classes: background, double plant, cloud shadow, waterway, planter skip, weed cluster, standing water. uav_collected=false: public dataset, not author-collected UAV imagery (collection platform aerial surveys).

mIoU.quote: We obtain an mIoU of 51.7% (on validation set) and 50.20% (on test set) for weed cluster segmentation
mIoU.ambiguity: Per-class IoU reported (weed cluster 0.517 val / 0.502 test; double plant 0.480 test; cloud shadow 0.491 val / 0.463 test); overall mean mIoU row values not extractable from available text.

F1.ambiguity: Reported as dice score/F1 score 67% (see Dice).

Dice.quote: For validation set, our predicted segmentation obtained a dice score/F1 score of 67%.
Dice.ambiguity: Aggregate dice/F1 score on Agriculture-Vision validation set.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Weed cluster per-class IoU reported (0.517 val / 0.502 test), not F1.

edge.device: None - offline (trained on NVIDIA Titan XP GPU, ~144 h; IoT cloud-deployment framework proposed, no edge benchmark)
edge.framework: PyTorch (batch size 4, SGD, cosine annealing LR 1e-2, dice loss + adaptive class weighting loss)

fps.ambiguity: Trained on NVIDIA Titan XP (144 h); no inference speed or edge hardware metrics.

issues: Overall mean mIoU not extractable from text dump (per-class IoU only); study covers multi-anomaly segmentation not only crop-weed
